title: Measurement: gold-pdf split layout, guide fixture families F1-F8, extract-eval boundary/cross-page/false-merge/incomplete-to-solver rates (design section 3, REQ-0045)
acceptance_criteria: REQ-0050 AC1 split layout and pages
REQ-0050 AC3 rates with Wilson intervals, expected counts independent
REQ-0050 AC4 honest 99.9% statement, no paid call

design.summary: gold-pdf --layout split and pages, fixture families F1-F8, extract-eval boundary/cross_page/missing_detection/false_merge/incomplete_to_solver as k/n with Wilson; mock vision replies for the scanned variant
risks: synthetic gold is an optimistic upper bound
new metrics must not change old outputs

implementation.summary: gold-pdf --layout split and per-question pages; families F1-F8 generator; extract-eval additive rates (boundary, cross_page, missing_detection, false_merge, incomplete_to_solver strict/content, content_errors, missing_to_solver, false_alarm) with Wilson; routes text, vision(mock), OCR

unit_test.result: 815 run, 3 known failures identical at base, new tests fail on base; old outputs byte-identical (24 runs); independent whitespace-stripped oracle 0 mismatches on text, vision and OCR; 4 mutations killed

security.result: synthetic text only, no network or model call; generators write only under work/ or tests fixtures

verification.command: unit suite vs base; byte identity of old outputs; independent oracle on F1-F8 over text, vision and OCR routes; corruption bites; Wilson and zero-error n recomputed
verification.result: text and vision (mock) boundary 200/200, cross-page 46/46, false merge 0/200, incomplete-to-solver 0/200, false alarm 8/200 (F5); OCR strict 168/200, spacing only 162, real errors 6/200, 6 unmarked reach the solver, missing 0/200; nothing claimed for 99.9% (needs n >= 2995)

quality.reason: independent fitz oracle on F1-F8 for three routes, byte identity of old outputs, corruption mutations move only their own rate

verifier.waiver: tester independent oracle and bites; coordinator re-ran the suite; no real-data claim
